whenToUse: You report a state that needs action, such as a failed payment or an account problem.
You announce something with a deadline, such as a closing date or upcoming maintenance.
You keep showing a state that affects the whole page.
whenNotToUse: You're reporting a light result of something just done.
The error belongs to a specific field.

alternatives.name: Toast
alternatives.reason: A result that only needs to show briefly.

alternatives.name: Modal Dialog
alternatives.reason: When an immediate decision is needed.

accessibility: Match the severity: role="alert" for errors, role="status" for the rest.
Convey severity with an icon and a title, not color alone.
The close button is icon-only, so give it an aria-label.
Keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 between text and background.
